snippet.title: Heroes of Hammerwatch II | Celestial Ruins Teaser
snippet.description:
The Celestial Ruins expansion comes to Heroes of Hammerwatch II on July 28th for $6.99 / €6.99 / £5.99! Undertake a new mission to a holy sanctum and survive the corruption that lurks there. Answer to a higher power as the new Priest class, infused with the righteous powers of mana and regeneration.

That’s not all! We’re also launching a free update on the same day to provide current players with even more content and improvements. 

What’s in the Paid Expansion? 
🙏 New Priest class - New (and legacy) abilities, with three brand-new subclasses 
🏛️ New mission
💪 New bosses - The Five Spirit Guardians of the Celestial Ruins. 
💍 7x new trinkets 
👕 2x new sets 
🐕 2x new pets 

What’s in the Free Update? 
💍 5x new trinkets 
👕 3x new sets 
🐕 5x new pets 
⚖️ Balancing fixes and improvements  

To celebrate this announcement, we’re giving two players the chance to win game keys for the DLC. To be in with a chance of winning, be sure to check out our official giveaway 👉 https://discord.gg/9x3Zzfzjz9
